strategy_name: Experimental IBIT Weekly Flow Pure Gate (paper)
rule: For each Monday-starting UTC week, use the prior completed Monday-Friday week's IBIT net USD flow. A negative flow sets exposure to 0% and holds non-interest-bearing cash; a zero or positive flow sets exposure to 100%. Rebalance at week start.

assumptions.flow_source: The Block BTC Spot ETF Flows, Series.IBIT.Data
assumptions.price_field: Adjusted close, falling back to close
